title: GoFlow
description: GoFlow is a concurrent job processing platform built with Go that enables users to submit long-running tasks through a REST API while background workers process them asynchronously. It features automatic retries, PostgreSQL persistence, graceful shutdown, and a live dashboard for monitoring jobs in real time.

title: SitePulse
description: SitePulse is a production-grade website and API uptime monitoring platform built with Go. It continuously monitors websites and APIs using a concurrent worker pool, records response times, status codes, SSL certificate health, and uptime metrics in PostgreSQL, detects outages, and supports email and webhook notifications. Built with Clean Architecture, background scheduling, graceful shutdown, JWT authentication, and Docker deployment to demonstrate production backend engineering beyond CRUD applications.
